info.title: ROMP API
info.description: The ROMP commerce API. Every write in the system passes through here. Generated from Zod contracts.

200.description: The service is up; returns version and commit.

post.summary: Register with email or mobile + password
Check whether an identifier is available
Change password (revokes other sessions)
Create an address (enforces the single-default invariant)

201.description: The created address, with its server-decided default.

patch.summary: Edit an address (promoting to default demotes the others)

delete.summary: Delete an address (the current default cannot be deleted while others exist)

put.summary: Add a product to the wishlist (idempotent; feature-gated)

delete.summary: Remove a product from the wishlist (idempotent; feature-gated)

post.summary: Mint a single-use password-reset link (WhatsApp-assisted)

200.description: A single-use, short-TTL reset link for the admin to relay.

post.summary: Create a draft product

201.description: The created product id and slug.

post.summary: Publish, unpublish or archive a product
Add a variant, refreshing the product summary

patch.summary: Edit a variant, refreshing the product summary

post.summary: Adjust a variant’s stock at one warehouse

200.description: The stock balance after the adjustment.

post.summary: Register a media upload slot

201.description: The Storage object path to upload to.

post.summary: Create a category

201.description: The created category id and slug.

post.summary: Reorder categories

delete.summary: Delete a category (refused while products or children depend on it)

get.summary: Read the cart (guest by cookie or signed-in by token)

post.summary: Add a variant to the cart, or set its quantity

delete.summary: Remove a line from the cart

post.summary: Merge the guest cart into the signed-in account
Quote the signed-in customer’s cart at live prices

get.summary: The signed-in customer’s order history, newest first

post.summary: Place the signed-in customer’s cart as an order (idempotent)

201.description: The placed order, with the UPI QR payload.

get.summary: Read one of the caller’s own orders

200.description: The order as the customer views it.

post.summary: Submit a UPI payment reference (and optional proof) for an order (idempotent)

409.description: `DUPLICATE_PAYMENT_REFERENCE` (Payment reference already used) — https://romp.dev/errors/duplicate-payment-reference; `RESERVATION_EXPIRED` (Reservation expired) — https://romp.dev/errors/reservation-expired; `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` (Invalid state transition) — https://romp.dev/errors/invalid-state-transition

get.summary: List orders — newest first, filterable by status or fulfilment, or searched by humanId

200.description: A page of orders, newest first.

post.summary: Verify a payment: commit stock and mark the order paid (exact amount)

409.description: `PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH` (Payment amount does not match the order total) — https://romp.dev/errors/payment-amount-mismatch; `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` (Invalid state transition) — https://romp.dev/errors/invalid-state-transition

post.summary: Reject a payment the admin could not match; the customer may resubmit

200.description: The rejected order, with the reason.

post.summary: Advance fulfilment: pack, ship (with carrier and tracking), deliver, or hold

200.description: The order at its new fulfilment stage.

post.summary: Cancel an order: release a held reservation, or restock a paid order
Issue a full or partial refund (owner-only, append-only, optional restock)

get.summary: The daily analytics rollups for a date range — the dashboard series

firebaseIdToken.description: Firebase ID token. Admin routes additionally require a role custom claim and verify token revocation on every request.
